Multimodal imaging combined with scar imaging, including the CARTO mapping system (Biosense, Diamond Bar, CA), CT, MRI and ^(99)^(m)Tc-sestamibi MPI, was used offline to delineate a target for ablation. A plan was developed in the Pinnacle3 planning system (version 9.8.1, Philips Medical Systems, Madison, WI, USA). One day before treatment, quality assurance was performed.
